text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (—To you.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(To you, who empathizes with an 
Umamusume's heart more than anyone, 
dedicating your all without holding back.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: (I—wish to dedicate a bouquet.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(So that the light shines upon you. So 
that everyone comes to know your warmth.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(A golden bouquet woven from the finest 
victories.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I've summarized everything. 
Let's see, the next class is—

text_block_list.name: Well-Informed Classmate
text_block_list.text:
"Bouquet! I heard your debut is set! 
Congratulations!"

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
You were super motivated during class, 
too. Did you have a change of heart, after 
all?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes... that's right. The Trainer in charge 
of me is a truly wonderful person.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
She's so rich in knowledge and experience— 
That's why I want to study hard, too.

text_block_list.name: Well-Informed Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I heard how amazing it was! A 
friend's Trainer is a junior to Bouquet's 
Trainer, you see.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so?

text_block_list.name: Well-Informed Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Ever since their academy days, she's been 
looking out for her, and even now, she 
still goes to her for all kinds of advice.

text_block_list.name: Well-Informed Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Whenever we hit a snag, they'd quickly 
look for solutions, and they were fast at 
spotting flaws in an Umamusume's form, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Well-Informed Classmate
text_block_list.text:
And thanks to that, the Umamusume they 
train—my friend—won a graded race! She was 
suuuper grateful!

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, amazing! Bouquet's Trainer must be a 
master trainer. Are there any interview 
articles? I'd love to read them.

text_block_list.name: Well-Informed Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I don't think an article has ever 
been written about Bouquet's Trainer yet.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really? Even though she's letting 
her juniors win...?

text_block_list.name: Well-Informed Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Just helping out only gets you so far, 
after all. A Trainer only steps into the 
spotlight once they lead their own Trainee 
to victory.

text_block_list.name: Well-Informed Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Look! Once Bouquet debuts and wins, she'll 
get the spotlight too! Right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —Yes.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, surely. That is what I intend, 
after all."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Starting tomorrow, our challenge in the 
Twinkle Series alongside Curren 
Bouquetd'or begins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I was handing over the duties I had 
taken on, such as assisting with away 
trips and training support.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I believe that is all of it. 
Still, that was an impressive amount.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
And so, lastly... Listen up, Trainer <username>! 
—Carve your name! Leave a massive mark on 
this world!
choice_data_list: What's gotten into you all of a sudden?
What's wrong, all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Well, dear... up until now, you've just 
been doing favors that don't help your 
career, like acting as a sub or 
sub-trainer. I'm worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Fellow Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Your long-awaited Umamusume trainee! Seize 
this chance and make a name for yourself, 
too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And with that energetic slap on my 
back, I couldn't help but give a wry 
smile.
choice_data_list: I'll do my best, putting Bouquet first!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *sigh*...――

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...! Oh my, what lovely wildflowers. It's 
already that time of year, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Blue, yellow, white... how lovely. They 
seem mismatched at a glance, yet there's a 
natural harmony to them—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Everyone is shining together, aren't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*tap, tap, tap, tap...*)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...? Oh my, that person is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The crisp air felt refreshing. While 
running along the riverbank and listening 
to race commentary archives for study, 
suddenly..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. I didn't expect to run into 
you at this hour.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that running is... your daily 
routine?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had only just started recently. It was 
a new routine she took up, changing her 
daily rhythm to build stamina so she 
wouldn't hold her back.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Even your daily rhythm— Isn't that taking 
a heavy toll on you?
choice_data_list: With a little ingenuity, it's no big deal.
With a little ingenuity, it's no big deal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I've gotten into the habit 
of waking up early and sleeping early, 
allowing me to spend my mornings 
productively."
choice_data_list:
You can study on the radio too, so it's 
two birds with one stone!

I can study while listening to the radio, 
so it's two birds with one stone!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I see, so that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And then, I remembered. I had prepared 
several menu proposals for today's 
training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had shared the data with her beforehand, 
planning to discuss and finalize our 
direction today.
choice_data_list: Do you have any thoughts on the menu?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She added that if none of these aligned 
with our plans, she would prepare a few 
more proposals before training.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Ah... No, they were all wonderful menu 
options. So much so that I can't even 
choose—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(To put together multiple extra proposals 
just to meet our wishes... Even though 
that must have been far more trouble than 
just deciding alone—)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, they suggest it as if it's no 
big deal at all.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(About the early morning run too—that's 
right. This person is surely, anytime, 
anywhere... Putting in effort for someone 
else's sake—)

text_block_list.name: Well-Informed Classmate
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... an article about Bouquet's Trainer 
shouldn't have been written yet."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I-I...! I'll run with everything I've got 
from now on...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"I will bundle together victories like 
single blooms, over and over, and present 
them to you as a grand bouquet—!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, um— Sorry for springing this on you 
out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...'To bring you light...' The more I get 
to know you, the more that feeling refuses 
to fade.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It is a presumptuous prayer. Even so, 
despite your behind-the-scenes 
contributions, there are still... very few 
people who truly know you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I am an Umamusume. By winning, I can make 
you shine.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Flower by flower, with each race to come, 
we can gather our victories into a 
bouquet.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And someday... I shall present a bouquet 
of shining gold—to you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to hand it over to them, 
without fail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Suddenly, I recall the day she scouted 
me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
And gathering more victories than my two 
hands can hold.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I want to deliver a golden-glowing 
bouquet to you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You told me the exact same thing on that 
day, too. ……To think you would care so 
deeply for a single trainer.
choice_data_list:
...Thank you. You really are kind, aren't 
you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to answer her earnest feelings. 
That was the very reason I took the scout 
offer to become her Trainer.
choice_data_list:
I want to support you so you can shine in 
your own unique way.

I want to support you so you can shine in 
your own way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A Trainer exists to guide Umamusume toward 
victory and happiness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until the day she can truly feel, from the 
bottom of her heart, that her wish has 
been granted—
choice_data_list: Let's give it our all, together!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Yes—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Twinkle Series begins. I want to 
faithfully fulfill my role to help her 
achieve the 'bouquet' she desires.
